name: Deposit dents
summary: The landlord kept part of the deposit: the apartment's floor plan with each charge marked in its room; tap a mark, then whose it is or shared, and each roommate's total updates under the plan; lock it and the requests go out.
useWhen: the landlord kept some of the security deposit: 'they kept $340: wall dent, burned counter, a missing blind'
arguing over who caused which damage at move-out
splitting deductions between roommates where some are one person's fault and some are shared
dontUseWhen: monthly rent shares (use rent-mailbox or rent-split)
an ordinary shared bill (use a bill split)

rooms.description: Up to 8 rooms; bedrooms and the bath go on the top row

owner.description: a roommate or 'shared', if already claimed
